title: Master Data Golden Record Contract
summary: Produce reversible golden records with field provenance and survivorship without taking source-system mutation ownership.

criteria: The contract deduplicates conflicting multi-source copies of the same real-world entity into one golden record, where every field stays bound to the source it came from.
The four declared dedup strategies are exact, fuzzy, phonetic and ML matching, and each candidate pair records which strategy proposed it and with what confidence.
survivorship decides which source wins per field rather than per record, so a golden record can take an address from one source and a tax identifier from another.
the survivorship rule is consumed as a computation_ref, not owned: the rule is a computation graph evaluated by computation-runtime-contract rather than a second engine defined here.
merge decisions are submitted to the PDP for evaluation, not decided here: policy-decision-point-contract remains the deciding authority for whether a proposed merge may proceed.
Every merge is reversible: an unmerge restores the contributing records with their original field-level provenance intact, so a wrong match is recoverable rather than destructive.
The merge and unmerge history is a tamper-evident merge trail, so an auditor can reconstruct which sources produced a golden field at any past point.

risks.desc: A merge that discards the contributing records makes a wrong match permanent: the original customer, supplier or product data can no longer be recovered once it has been collapsed.
risks.mitigation: Make every merge reversible by construction, keep contributing records and their provenance intact and prove that a merge followed by an unmerge is a no-op on source data.

risks.desc: A fuzzy or phonetic match crossing a tenant boundary would fuse two customers' master data, which is both a correctness failure and a data-protection breach.
risks.mitigation: Scope every candidate pair to one tenant, refuse a cross-tenant candidate rather than rescoping it and prove the refusal with a dedicated negative.

risks.desc: Recording provenance only per record rather than per field would make a golden record unexplainable: nobody could say which system supplied a disputed value.
risks.mitigation: Bind provenance to each field, keep the merge trail append-only and tamper-evident and prove field-level attribution across three conflicting sources.

risks.desc: Owning the survivorship rule inside MDM would duplicate the computation runtime and let two engines disagree about the same derived value.
risks.mitigation: Consume the rule as a computation_ref, keep decision authority with the PDP and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: The contract sağlar one golden record per real-world entity, assembled from conflicting multi-source copies rather than by trusting a single system.
Girdi is a set of source records plus a tenant scope; çıktı is a golden record with field-level provenance, a confidence-scored candidate set and a merge trail entry.
The declared dedup strategies are exact, fuzzy, phonetic and ML matching, and survivorship decides the winning source per field rather than per record.
Every merge is reversible through an unmerge that restores the contributing records and their provenance, recorded in a tamper-evident merge trail.

Kapsam sınırı gereği source-system mutation ownership is excluded, genealogy and lineage ownership is excluded, bitemporal as-of restatement is excluded and data quality scoring and enrichment are excluded.
featureDefs.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/featureDefs: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
featureDefs.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract featureDefs kapsamı. Kapsa: one golden record per entity, the four dedup strategies, per-field survivorship and provenance, reversible merges and a tamper-evident trail. Exclude source-system mutation, genealogy, as-of restatement and data quality enrichment. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Merging master data fuses identities, so tenant izolasyon is the primary control: a cross-tenant merge candidate is refused rather than rescoped, and erişim to a golden record stays inside its tenant.
merge decisions are submitted to the PDP for evaluation, not decided here, so no MDM path can approve its own privileged fusion of two records.
Reversibility is a security property as much as a correctness one: an unmerge restores the contributing records, which limits the blast radius of a malicious or mistaken match.
The merge trail is append-only and tamper-evident, so every merge and unmerge leaves a denetim izi naming the actor, the strategy and the confidence.
source-system mutation ownership is excluded, which keeps the contract read-only toward the originating systems and removes it as a write path into them.

security.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract security kapsamı. Kapsa: cross-tenant merge refusal, PDP as the merge authority, reversibility as blast-radius control, tamper-evident audit, read-only stance toward source systems. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one tipli matching katman behind a strategy-neutral port so exact, fuzzy, phonetic and ML matching cannot develop divergent candidate semantics.
Candidate generation and survivorship application stay pure functions with low karmaşıklık, testable from fixed source fixtures without a live ingestion pipeline.
Ölü kod and speculative per-domain matchers are refused, the short-code bütçe is respected, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: En az ayrıcalık separates proposing a candidate, approving a merge and performing an unmerge, so no single role can fuse and then hide a record.
The accepted strategy set is an allowlist of exact, fuzzy, phonetic and ML matching, so an unrecognised matcher cannot introduce untracked candidates.
The write yüzey stays kapalı: the contract writes golden records and provenance only, and every source system remains read-only from here.
Automatic merge is bounded by a confidence threshold and a per-tenant rate, so a bulk low-confidence sweep cannot quietly collapse a master data set.
securityOptimization.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: separated propose, approve and unmerge privileges, allowlisted matching strategies, closed write surface, confidence and rate bounded automatic merges. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for resolving a golden record by key and a separate budget for a candidate generation pass over a blocking key; no measurement is claimed here.
Candidate search is bounded by a blocking strategy plus an index rather than pairwise comparison, so cost grows with block size instead of quadratically with the corpus.
Golden record reads must avoid N+1 access: field-level provenance is fetched with the record in one pass rather than once per field.
performance.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budgets for golden record resolution and candidate generation, index-backed blocking instead of pairwise comparison, single-pass provenance fetch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client reads a golden record together with the provenance of the fields it displays; a cihaz may not propose or approve a merge on its own authority.
An offline client shows the last synchronised golden record as stale and refuses to queue a merge or unmerge for later replay, since both require a live PDP decision.
No mobile-only matching strategy or steward surface is introduced here; rendering a golden record stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: record plus provenance on mobile, no device-side merge proposal or approval, stale offline display without queued merges, no mobile-only strategy. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future stewardship surface must convey a conflicting field, its winning source and the match confidence through text rather than colour alone, at the WCAG AAA kontrast threshold with a visible odak ring.
A merge or unmerge outcome must be announced through an aria live region naming the affected records, so a klavye-only reviewer is never left guessing what was fused.
This contract defines merge semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: non-colour-only conveyance of conflicts, winning sources and confidence at AAA contrast, announced merge outcomes, keyboard-first review, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; the hosting topology and container dağıtım of any matching service remain human-developer work behind ops-plane authority.
Changing a survivorship rule or a confidence threshold is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a redeploy; rollback returns to the previous rule.
Reverting this MDM shard changes the planning contract and the projections derived from it, never a golden record or a source system, so runtimeDataImpact stays none and NO-GO remains in force.
deployment.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, hosting owned by the ops plane, data-level rule and threshold changes without redeploy, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A merge or unmerge olay may be announced so consumers refresh their view of an entity, but this contract never performs a business action on the fused record.
A reaction chain raised from a merge olay stops at maxChainDepth 6, so a bulk deduplication run cannot cascade into an unbounded downstream rewrite.
Re-delivering the same merge olay must be idempoten, and changing a survivorship rule or confidence threshold always requires an explicit onay.
eca.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: merge and unmerge events without business actions, depth-bounded reaction chains, idempotent replay and approval-gated rule changes. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay yasak.
An ML matcher may propose a candidate but can never approve a merge, perform an unmerge or change a survivorship rule; each of those needs insan onayı with a step-up review.

Any source-supplied record text reaching the lane as sub_prompt is güvenilmez, the kill-switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 sınır or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, ML matchers propose but never approve, step-up for merges, unmerges and rule changes, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases build a golden record from three conflicting sources and assert per-field provenance names the winning source, as birim and entegrasyon matrices.
Planned negatif cases prove each of exact, fuzzy, phonetic and ML matching records its own strategy and confidence rather than an unattributed match.
Planned negatif cases prove an unmerge restores contributing records and provenance exactly, so a merge followed by an unmerge is a no-op on source data.
Planned negatif cases prove a PDP-denied merge is not applied and that a cross-tenant candidate is refused rather than rescoped.
Merge results are recordable only from a human-approved run that truly executed, so the planned matrices here are never counted as passing tests.
testing.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: multi-source golden record positives with per-field provenance, per-strategy attribution negatives, unmerge reversibility negatives, PDP denial and cross-tenant negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is the defining axis: refusing cross-tenant candidates and routing every merge through the PDP is what keeps one tenant's identities out of another's.
OWASP A08 software and data integrity failures is modeled by the append-only tamper-evident merge trail and by reversible merges, so a fusion cannot silently rewrite history.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by excluding source-system mutation, which removes the possibility of MDM becoming an unaudited write path into an ERP or marketplace.
Girdi doğrulama applies to every source record: the tenant scope, strategy and confidence are validated before a candidate is admitted, and each decision leaves a denetim izi.
owasp.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 via cross-tenant refusal and PDP routing, A08 via tamper-evident reversible trail, A04 via excluded source mutation, candidate validation with audit. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-computation with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-mdm] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so a merge touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; it is announced as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor computation-runtime-contract ends 2028-04-30, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.

Bağımlılık yönü stays exactly computation-runtime-contract and policy-decision-point-contract, and the parent related list is not inherited; s-pim and s-data-cleansing are consumers rather than dependencies.
Scope stays inside the master data sözleşme: source-system mutation ownership, genealogy and lineage ownership, bitemporal as-of restatement and data quality scoring and enrichment all stay outside.
integration.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-archetype-computation to provider k-mdm, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, consumers named without absorption, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir a golden record through this contract and may not run its own deduplication or reach a doğrudan tablo for the contributing source rows.
A consumer must carry the golden record key and the provenance of any field it stores, so a later unmerge can be reconciled against what it cached.

s-pim and s-data-cleansing are consumers of this sözleşme rather than absorbed into it, and owning the derivation engine and the merge decision belongs to computation-runtime-contract and policy-decision-point-contract respectively.
moduleUsage.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: contract-mediated golden record consumption without local dedup or direct table reads, key and provenance carried with cached fields, named consumers and externally owned engine and decision. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: Master data about customers and suppliers is directly PII, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir and a deletion must propagate to the golden record as well as to its contributing copies.
The merge trail has its own saklama süresi, longer than a single golden record, because reversibility is only meaningful while the trail that describes the merge is still readable.
The merge trail is retained append-only so an unmerge adds a reversal rather than erasing history, and records evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: direct PII in master data with KVKK/GDPR classification and DSAR propagation to golden and contributing records, merge trail retention, append-only reversal and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrik set includes candidate generation latency, automatic merge rate by strategy, unmerge rate and PDP denial rate on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the golden record key class, strategy and confidence; source field values and personal identifiers are redacted and never become metric labels.
Alarm coverage includes an unmerge spike suggesting a bad matcher, a cross-tenant candidate surge and an automatic merge rate above its bound; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: candidate latency and merge-rate SLIs, redacted strategy-scoped traces, unmerge spike and cross-tenant candidate alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The dominant failure mode is a partially applied merge; the contributing records stay authoritative until the merge commits, so no entity is ever left half-fused.
Merge and unmerge are idempoten by construction: replaying the same decision for the same candidate pair yields the same golden state under a bounded retry with backoff.
A repeatedly failing merge is routed to a dead-letter path for steward review rather than blocking the tenant's ingestion queue, and a circuit breaker protects the shared matching path.
reliability.notes: master-data-golden-record-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Master Data Golden Record Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: authoritative contributing records until commit, idempotent merge and unmerge with bounded retry, dead-letter routing without head-of-line blocking and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
